context.transcript:
Welcome to the annual Cabrillo Cooking Championships.
We've brought together the best chefs from local restaurants for a friendly contest.
My name is Felipe Sanchez, host of the cooking show I Cooked It Myself.
Now let's get started with the competition.
This year the challenge is to prepare a spaghetti sauce using vegetables grown in the area.
The chefs have one hour and then the judges will select a winner.
By the way, don't forget to enter our raffle.
Just write down your phone number and email address.
One lucky winner will receive a free dinner at a downtown restaurant.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎来到一年一度的 Cabrillo 烹饪大赛。
我们汇集了当地餐厅的最佳厨师们参加一场友谊赛。
我的名字是 Felipe Sanchez，我是烹饪节目 I Cooked It Myself 的主持人。
现在让我们开始比赛吧。
今年的挑战是用当地种植的蔬菜来制作意大利面酱。
厨师们有一个小时的时间，然后评委将选出一位获胜者。
顺便说一句，别忘了参加我们的抽奖活动。
只需写下您的电话号码和电子邮件地址。
一位幸运的赢家将在市中心的一家餐厅获得一顿免费晚餐。
